item.pocketpages.unlock_slot.desc: Right-click to unlock one more extra slot. Sneak-right-click to open your inventory.
item.pocketpages.unlock_slot.disabled: This item is disabled because Require Experience to Unlock is turned off.
item.pocketpages.locked_slot.desc: Internal placeholder item used to reserve disabled slots.
pocketpages.configuration.title: PocketPages Configuration
pocketpages.configuration.server.tooltip: Settings shared by the server and its clients.
pocketpages.configuration.client.tooltip: Settings that affect only the local client.
pocketpages.configuration.debug.tooltip: Troubleshooting settings. Leave these disabled during normal play.
pocketpages.configuration.total_extra_sl: Total slots managed by PocketPages, excluding the hotbar. Client and server must use the same value.
pocketpages.configuration.start_unlocked: Number of slots unlocked for a new player.
pocketpages.configuration.require_experi: When disabled, every configured slot is available immediately.
pocketpages.configuration.unlock_cost.to: Cost of the next slot in levels, or experience points when raw experience mode is enabled.
pocketpages.configuration.unlock_cost_in: Additional cost for each slot unlocked after the initial allocation.
pocketpages.configuration.use_experience: Charge raw experience points instead of experience levels.
pocketpages.configuration.keep_unlocks_o: Keep unlocked slots when keepInventory is disabled.
pocketpages.configuration.remember_conta: Reopen ordinary containers on the most recently viewed extended inventory page.
pocketpages.configuration.locked_item_dr: Ticks between locked-slot checks. One tick provides immediate cleanup.
Logs detailed virtual inventory paging, slot positions, item movement, and synchronization. Enable only when investigating a problem.
